headline: TRIDENT RESOURCES CRACKS 41.46 g/t AU OVER 3.4m AT EX-CAMECO CONTACT LAKE — ALL 7 FINAL WINTER HOLES HIT GOLD IN SASKATCHEWAN BK3 ZONE
snippet: Trident Resources Ltd. (TSXV: ROCK) released June 17, 2026 the final 7 assay results from its 10,127-metre, 29-hole winter drill program at the BK3 Zone of the Contact Lake Gold Project in northern Saskatchewan — a former Cameco exploration site. The headline hole CL26033 returned 41.46 g/t Au over 3.42 metres including 81.75 g/t Au over 1.73 metres, with companion hole CL26045 delivering 5.43 g/t Au over 16.00 metres from 206 metres depth. Every single hole in the 29-hole winter program intersected high-grade gold mineralization, validating the BK3 Zone's scale. A 20,000-metre summer drill program has now commenced with two rigs on site, targeting the Contact Lake deposit at depth and along strike to the west. At $4,244+ gold, a Saskatchewan high-grade gold discovery where 100% of 29 holes hit pay — including multiple 40+ g/t intercepts — and a summer program already running represents one of the most consistently successful junior gold drill campaigns active in Canada right now.

headline: BANYAN GOLD FINDS 5.58 g/t AU OVER 21.7m NEW HIGH-GRADE ZONE IN 8.6 MOZ YUKON RESOURCE — 62.66 g/t SPIKE IN POWERLINE DEPOSIT CORE
source_name: Yahoo Finance / Banyan Gold Corp. (TSXV: BYN)
snippet: Banyan Gold Corp. (TSXV: BYN) announced June 17, 2026 the intersection of a new high-grade gold zone southwest of the main high-grade core in the Powerline Deposit at its AurMac Project in Yukon — delivering 5.58 g/t Au over 21.7 metres, within which 13.00 g/t Au runs over 9.2 metres, and a bonanza-grade spike of 62.66 g/t Au over 1.8 metres. The AurMac Project, 40 kilometres from Mayo, Yukon, hosts a current mineral resource (effective May 15, 2026) of 3.639 million ounces Indicated at 0.68 g/t Au and 4.985 million ounces Inferred at 0.58 g/t Au — making it one of the largest undeveloped bulk-tonnage gold systems in Canada. The discovery of a new high-grade zone with 13 g/t over 9 metres adjacent to the known deposit boundary, within a system that already has 8.6 Moz of defined ounces, raises the scenario of a structurally controlled high-grade core that could reshape the economics of future extraction well beyond the bulk-tonnage base case.

headline: HELIOSTAR HITS 22.1 g/t AU OVER 10.9m AT LA COLORADA AND RECEIVES FINAL SOIL PERMIT — VETA MADRE PIT EXPANSION CLEARS FOR Q3 COMMENCEMENT
source_name: Investing News Network / Heliostar Metals Ltd. (TSXV: HSTR)
snippet: Heliostar Metals Ltd. (TSXV: HSTR) announced June 18, 2026 new drill results from the Veta Madre pit area at its operating La Colorada gold mine in Sonora, Mexico, combined with receipt of the final Change of Use of Soils permit required to commence the Veta Madre pit expansion. Drill highlights include 10.9 metres grading 22.1 g/t Au from 187.7 metres including 1.3 metres at 174 g/t Au, 40.8 metres at 2.23 g/t Au from 51.3 metres including 17.45 metres at 4.55 g/t Au, and 147.2 metres at 0.70 g/t Au from 32.65 metres. With all environmental and soil-use permits now in hand, the company is on track to commence the larger Veta Madre Plus pit cutback in Q3 2026, with production from the pit expected in H1 next year. For investors in junior gold producers, a dual catalyst — strong infill grades adjacent to planned stopes plus final permits for expansion — at an already-operating Sonora mine at $4,244/oz gold creates a low-execution-risk near-term production growth story.

headline: NINE MILE METALS DISCOVERS NEW COPPER-RICH VMS HORIZON AT DEPTH — 234m SULPHIDE COLUMN IN NEW BRUNSWICK BATHURST CAMP
source_name: Newsfile Corp. / Nine Mile Metals Inc. (CSE: NINE, OTCQB: VMSXF)
snippet: Nine Mile Metals Inc. (CSE: NINE) announced June 17, 2026 that drill hole DDH WD-26-02 at its Wedge Mine target in New Brunswick's Bathurst VMS camp intersected base metal sulphides, pyrite, and chalcopyrite mineralisation from 39.20 to 273.35 metres — a 234.15-metre column — with two distinct VMS horizons. The upper zone runs from 105.8 to 114.3 metres; the deeper new horizon from 204.6 to 222.3 metres is 70% sulphide-dominant with visible copper, lead, and zinc minerals confirmed by on-site XRF. This is a visual result pending certified assays from ALS Global, but the 17.7-metre lower horizon at 70% sulphide intensity in a known polymetallic VMS district — where Nine Mile's prior certified hole WD-25-2B returned 3.17% CuEq over 15 metres including 5.99% CuEq over 6.84 metres — makes the discovery context immediately significant. The Bathurst camp is one of Canada's most productive VMS districts, hosting historic operations including Brunswick #12, and a new copper-rich horizon at depth expands the system's 3D footprint before assays arrive.

headline: BLM GREENLIGHTS INFRASTRUCTURE CONSTRUCTION AT ENCORE ENERGY'S DEWEY BURDOCK — SOUTH DAKOTA ISR URANIUM PROJECT CLEARS FEDERAL HURDLE
source_name: Investing News Network / enCore Energy Corp. (NYSE American: EU, TSX: EU)
snippet: The U.S. Bureau of Land Management authorized enCore Energy Corp. (NYSE American: EU) on June 17, 2026 to commence infrastructure construction at the Dewey Burdock In-Situ Recovery Uranium Project in Southwest South Dakota — approving access roads, groundwater monitoring wells, and overhead power lines on approximately 240 acres of BLM-managed public land within the 10,580-acre project boundary. The BLM's Environmental Assessment, published April 14, 2026, addressed public comments on groundwater, tribal concerns, and cultural resources before issuing the construction decision. The authorization does not yet cover production well fields, processing facilities, or uranium extraction — those remain subject to separate NRC and EPA permitting — but the BLM approval removes a critical infrastructure access hurdle on federal land and positions Dewey Burdock to advance toward site readiness in parallel with ongoing regulatory work. At uranium spot near $86/lb with US utilities aggressively contracting ahead of the January 2028 Russian-origin import ban, a BLM green light on a FAST-41-designated South Dakota ISR project is a concrete construction-readiness milestone for a domestic uranium supply-chain thesis.

headline: RELEVANT GOLD SOUTH PASS VTEM MAPS 44 ANOMALIES AND 3km GOLD CORRIDORS TO 400m DEPTH IN WYOMING
source_name: Toronto Telegraph / Relevant Gold Corp. (TSXV: RGC, OTCQB: RGCCF)
snippet: Relevant Gold Corp. (TSXV: RGC) announced June 18, 2026 that its completed 2,807 line-kilometre VTEM and magnetics survey across the 100%-owned South Pass Gold Camp in Wyoming identified 44 electromagnetic anomalies — 15 of which are classified as high-priority drill targets — and outlined structural corridors at the Lewiston area traceable for more than 3 kilometres along strike and to more than 400 metres depth. Several high-priority targets coincide with known gold-bearing structures, historic mine workings, surface geochemical anomalies, and projected extensions of mineralized trends defined by the company's 2024 drilling and 2025 exploration campaigns. The overlap between VTEM responses and multiple independent mineralisation indicators confirms that the gold-hosting shears at Lewiston continue at depth well beyond what surface exposures and 2024 drilling reached — the VTEM data now provides subsurface targeting vectors for the planned 2026 drill program at Lewiston. South Pass is Wyoming's historic gold district, and the definition of 15 drill-ready targets across a 35,000-acre camp represents a meaningful step toward drill mobilisation at a project in a low-sovereign-risk US jurisdiction.

headline: GOLDCLIFF TRACES 12m CONTINUOUS GOLD AT BC'S KETTLE VALLEY — 2.9 g/t AU AND 130 g/t AG VEIN LOCKS IN FIRST DRILL TARGETS
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Goldcliff Resource Corporation (TSXV: GCN)
snippet: Goldcliff Resource Corporation (TSXV: GCN) released June 18, 2026 assay results from its April 2026 hand trenching program at the Kettle Valley Gold-Silver Project in south-central British Columbia — highlighting a quartz-calcite breccia vein grading 2.886 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag, and a 12-metre continuous gold-mineralised interval averaging 0.646 g/t Au that establishes a coherent strike length for the first drill campaign. The Kettle Valley project is located in the same geological belt as the historic Hedley gold district, and the combination of a high-grade breccia vein metric — 130 g/t Ag alongside 2.9 g/t Au is a classic epithermal signature — with 12 metres of corridor continuity provides the structural justification needed to convert surface showings into diamondcore drill targets. For BC gold investors, the results represent the target-definition milestone that gates a maiden drill program, converting Kettle Valley from a sampling-stage play to a drill-ready junior with grade-confirmed targets in a historically productive BC gold belt.
